name: alchemy-likec4
description: Generate a LikeC4 specification from alchemy's resource registry

scripts.example:generate: bun run example:basic && bun run example:shortener
scripts.example:basic: bun run src/cli.ts spec --project examples/basic/docs/architecture --provider Cloudflare && bun run src/cli.ts deployment --project examples/basic/docs/architecture --entrypoint examples/basic/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod
scripts.example:shortener: bun run src/cli.ts spec --project examples/link-shortener/docs/architecture && bun run src/cli.ts deployment --project examples/link-shortener/docs/architecture --entrypoint examples/link-shortener/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod && bun run src/cli.ts deployment --project examples/link-shortener/docs/architecture --entrypoint examples/link-shortener/alchemy.run.ts --stage staging
scripts.example:png: likec4 export png examples/basic/docs/architecture --flat --notation -o . && mv index.png screenshot.png
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run example:generate && bun run example:validate && bun test
